picks.editorial_note: A $14.2M DOE Genesis Mission award to build a national AI foundation model for the electric grid is a flagship federal investment tying a national lab and university directly to critical infrastructure modernization.
picks.title: BNL to Lead $14M AI Project for Nation's Electric Grid Through Genesis Mission

picks.editorial_note: A $10M OpenAI Foundation grant (part of $60M) to bring AI weather and crop-disease forecasting to millions of farmers is a rare case of AI research translating directly into large-scale humanitarian and agricultural impact.
picks.title: AIM for Scale receives $10 million to bring AI-powered weather services to millions of farmers

picks.editorial_note: UNSW's rollout of ChatGPT Edu to over 80,000 students and staff is one of the largest AI-in-education deployments in the Asia-Pacific region, signaling how deeply industry partnerships are reshaping higher education at scale.
picks.title: UNSW partners with OpenAI to support the first generation of AI natives in the workforce

picks.editorial_note: University of Kentucky's selection for a DOE-backed national team on mine safety and automation shows AI's expanding role in federal industrial modernization initiatives.
picks.title: UK selected to help advance DOE ‘Mine of the Future’ initiative

picks.editorial_note: OpenAI's claim of solving a Millennium Prize math problem, met with public skepticism from UCLA's Terence Tao, is a significant flashpoint in the debate over how AI capability claims are verified and reported.
picks.title: OpenAI says it has solved one of math’s 'Millennium Problems' — and more UCLA media

picks.editorial_note: Sandia's ETCRAM analog memory technology, achieving 100x density gains over conventional binary storage, is a hardware breakthrough with direct implications for more efficient on-device AI.
picks.title: New analog memory may make smart devices even smarter

picks.editorial_note: An Australia-first pilot making AI data-center workloads dynamically shiftable addresses one of the industry's most pressing problems — the strain AI compute places on power grids — through a multi-institution partnership.
picks.title: Australia-first pilot to transform data centres from static loads into dynamic grid aware assets

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL's InstructMesh tool for repairing and fabricating AI-generated 3D models, developed with Google and Northeastern, advances practical human-AI co-design workflows in manufacturing.
picks.title: New tool lets users repair AI-generated 3D models, then fabricate them just the way they want

picks.editorial_note: USF's $40 million Bellini College of Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity and Computing building reflects a major institutional bet on AI education infrastructure.
picks.title: USF President Limayem announces location, unveils plans for new Bellini College building

picks.editorial_note: EPFL's new AI technique for detecting microplastics down to five micrometers is a concrete scientific advance with direct environmental-monitoring applications.
picks.title: Hidden microplastic pollution in Swiss waters uncovered
